correctness.rationale: Independently re-executed both committed scripts from scratch. sieve.py sieved [1030000000,1050000000] in ~0.6s yielding C=61310, G=3870 at gap index 19459 between (1036385639,1036385641) and (1036389509,1036389511), cousin (1030000567,1030000571). verify.py (independent odds-only sieve with trial-division base primes, deterministic MR bases 2,7,61) reproduced twins.json/gaps.json byte-identically (SHA256 4ab6fb9c...1b5c5 / 1b6e0189...4ec9649) and printed VERIFY_OK with six MR True lines. Auditor cross-checked: sum(g)=19999698=T[-1]-T[0]; 61309 gaps all multiples of 6, min 6, mean ~326.21, median 228, 2571 >=1000, unique maximum; first/last twins 1030000259/1049999957 with upper member <=HI; sorted strictly increasing; boundary loop covers all odd p<=1049999997 correctly. All six witness primes confirmed prime by independent trial division; DRAFT MR transcripts (d,s,x0 chains) re-derived exactly via pow() and match. Prefix twins and cousin minimality (no (0,4) before 1030000567) spot-confirmed by trial division. Bases 2,7,61 are deterministic for n<2^32; all witnesses ~1.03e9. No prime database used. DRAFT statistics match recomputation exactly. Claim is computational certificate honestly limited to the interval, not an asymptotic proof.

originality.rationale: Live-checked nearest priors substantively. MathWorld Twin Primes gives global pi2(10^n) to 1e19, Hardy-Littlewood asymptotic, Brun theorem, bounded gap 246 — no window twin-interarrival log or maximal certificate in [1.03e9,1.05e9]. OEIS A007508 plus Oliveira e Silva tables give cumulative global pi2 counts only. PrimePages Gaps Between Primes defines consecutive-prime gaps g(p), average log p, record first occurrences — a different sequence. Prime Gap List Project curates consecutive-prime record gaps/merits, not twin-interarrival spectrum. Gourdon-Sebah twin page gives global enumeration methods, p2 vs 2C2Li2 to 1e16, Rd factors and Brun extrapolation — no local maximal twin-gap census. Global counts do not record or mechanically imply the ordered 61310-entry sequence, the 61309-entry gap log, G=3870 at the stated pairs, or window-first cousin (1030000567,1030000571). Internal SCOPE070 covers disjoint [1e9,1e9+2e6] consecutive-prime gaps/quadruplets, a different object and window. Object shift from consecutive gaps to twin-interarrival gaps is a different density/statistic, not parameter substitution.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object: complete twin-lower sequence (C=61310), full interarrival-gap log, unique maximal gap G=3870 with explicit certified endpoint pairs, plus window-first cousin witness in the round-boundary 20M window near the 1e9 calibration region. Object and invariant were motivated before computation (twin distribution, Hardy-Littlewood k-tuple conjecture, bounded-gaps/heuristic calibration documented by twin-count tables and gap-curation program). Value was not known or mechanically implied by global pi2 counts or consecutive-gap records. A future researcher can reasonably need the precise log as a citable ground-truth calibration point for twin-gap heuristics and tuple-search verification near 1e9. Judged as headline exact result, not as general theorem; incomplete surrounding survey is absent here — the census is complete for the committed window. Certification strengthens but is not the sole basis for value.
